related.title: 振盪水柱波浪發電系統
related.titleEn: Oscillating Water Column Wave Energy Systems
related.transfer: 可遷移「理論的最大擷取寬度」與「極端波浪下的浮力變化」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；振盪水柱波浪發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Theoretical maximum capture width" and "Buoyancy change in extreme waves" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Oscillating Water Column Wave Energy Systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦隨波起伏的浮筒：自然週期、相位調諧、擷取寬度、暴風生存與疲勞循環；振盪水柱波浪發電系統則以用海浪推動空氣、再用空氣推動渦輪機：波浪功率、氣流速度、威爾斯渦輪機與波壓為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A buoy riding the waves: natural period, phase tuning, capture width, storm survival and fatigue cycles; Oscillating Water Column Wave Energy Systems centres on waves pushing air and air driving a turbine: wave power, air speed, the Wells turbine and wave pressure, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「波浪功率通量」與「波浪功率通量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「調諧所需的等效剛度」的模型移到振盪水柱波浪發電系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「水柱的自然週期」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Wave energy flux" and "Wave energy flux".
Move the model of "Effective stiffness needed for tuning" to Oscillating Water Column Wave Energy Systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Natural period of the water column", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「理論的最大擷取寬度」與「極端波浪下的浮力變化」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；振盪水柱波浪發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Theoretical maximum capture width" and "Buoyancy change in extreme waves" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Oscillating Water Column Wave Energy Systems must be respecified.

related.title: 潮流渦輪機海床固定系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「理論的最大擷取寬度」與「極端波浪下的浮力變化」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；潮流渦輪機海床固定系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Theoretical maximum capture width" and "Buoyancy change in extreme waves" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Tidal Turbine Seabed Mounting Systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦隨波起伏的浮筒：自然週期、相位調諧、擷取寬度、暴風生存與疲勞循環；潮流渦輪機海床固定系統則以把渦輪機固定在急流的海床上：傾覆力矩、重力基座、鑽孔樁、沖刷與作業時窗為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A buoy riding the waves: natural period, phase tuning, capture width, storm survival and fatigue cycles; Tidal Turbine Seabed Mounting Systems centres on fixing a turbine to the seabed in a tidal race: overturning moment, gravity bases, drilled piles, scour and working windows, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「波浪功率通量」與「潮流功率密度」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「調諧所需的等效剛度」的模型移到潮流渦輪機海床固定系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「葉片通過頻率」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Wave energy flux" and "Power of a tidal stream".
Move the model of "Effective stiffness needed for tuning" to Tidal Turbine Seabed Mounting Systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Blade-passing frequency", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「理論的最大擷取寬度」與「極端波浪下的浮力變化」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；潮流渦輪機海床固定系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Theoretical maximum capture width" and "Buoyancy change in extreme waves" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Tidal Turbine Seabed Mounting Systems must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 點吸收式波浪能轉換器
history.text: 2012 年開發公司成立；2018 年半尺度裝置在奧克尼完成海上試驗；2023 年全尺度裝置在葡萄牙送電。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2012: The developer was founded. 2018: A half-scale device completed sea trials in Orkney. 2023: The full-scale device exported power in Portugal. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
